frozen_resolution_rule.quoted_rule: This market will resolve according to the 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait that IMF Portwatch reports for October 31, 2026. Transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.
frozen_resolution_rule.date_and_fallback: Resolve as soon as data is published. If it is not published within 14 calendar days of October 31, use the most recent data then available. Obvious data-integrity issues may delay resolution until the end of the third ET day after first release for correction; use the unrounded value.
frozen_resolution_rule.scope_note: The rule specifies 7-day mean, transit calls, named chokepoint, and Oct 31 reference date. It does not name an API field.
